reply: near A≈3.5 at early times. The time exponent also seems to rise with A, from about 0.5 at A≈0.25 to about 1 at A≈3. Sparse monomial fits, separable two-term fits and ln/rational/saturating forms all plateaued around 1e-4 to 3e-4, so the true law probably has a different interaction between t and A.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    return -p[0]*t**p[1]*A**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*A) + p[4]*t**p[5]*A**p[6]*np.log(A+p[7]) + p[8]*A*t**p[9]
